title: Las ideas liberales
goal: Read about the liberal creed of equal citizenship, and the property and literacy requirements that quietly excluded most of the population from actually voting.

items: Name the core values liberalism claimed to defend.
Explain who could actually vote under most 19th-century liberal constitutions.
Explain who the literacy requirement excluded in particular.
State whether this contradiction went unnoticed at the time.
Use formal consequence connectors (en consecuencia, por consiguiente, como consecuencia, por lo tanto) without repeating the same one.
I can name the core values liberalism claimed to defend.
I can explain who could actually vote under most 19th-century liberal constitutions.
I can explain who the literacy requirement excluded in particular.
